input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，有一个男孩名字叫孟子。孟子和孟子的妈妈两个人住在很穷的农村。他们住的地方旁边是个墓地，墓地老是有很多人祭拜。因为人们在祭拜，他们一直在哭。孟子和孟子的妈妈住在这里才一个星期就觉得受不了了，而且害得孟子的学习。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候：在古代
- 而且害得孟子的学习：害得孟子的学习不好，害得 + harmful result

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，this time expression is redundant because 古代 already names a time period, while 的时候 also means “at the time of.”
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 有一个男孩名字叫孟子：有一个叫孟子的男孩，use the modifier structure “叫…的” before the noun to introduce a named character clearly.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 老是：常常，老是 usually carries a negative, complaining tone; this sentence neutrally describes a frequent event.
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 害得孟子的学习：影响了孟子的学习，害得 must be followed by a person and a harmful result clause; it cannot directly take a noun phrase such as “孟子的学习.”
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子的妈妈两个人：孟子和他的妈妈两个人，when the same character is mentioned again within the same clause, use a pronoun rather than repeating the name.
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 因为人们在祭拜，他们一直在哭：因为人们在祭拜，一直在哭，within the same sentence, use zero form for the repeated subject; 他们 could also be confused with the boy and his mother mentioned earlier.
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子的妈妈住在这里：孟子和他的妈妈住在这里，after naming 孟子, use the pronoun in the possessive phrase rather than repeating his name.
8. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 住在这里才一个星期就觉得受不了了：在这里才住了一个星期就觉得受不了了，use 了 with 住 to mark the completed one-week period before the following reaction.

items.reason: 古代 already expresses a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundantly formed under the teacher's rule.
有一个男孩名字叫孟子 is a grammatical and clear way to introduce the character, although the proposed wording is also correct.
老是 can appropriately convey the bothersome repeated sacrificing and crying in this context.
害得 requires a person plus a harmful resulting clause, so it cannot end with 孟子的学习 alone.
孟子的妈妈 is appropriate when the mother is being introduced for the first time; repeating 孟子 here is not an error.
他们 clearly refers to the immediately preceding 人们 and is acceptable; zero subject is optional here.
After the earlier introduction, repeating 孟子 inside 孟子的妈妈 is unnecessarily repetitive, while 他的妈妈 gives the intended reference clearly.
The one-week stay is completed before the reaction, so 住 needs 了, and 才住了一个星期 has the correct order.
